Pakistan Names And Emblems (Prevention Of Unauthorised Use) Rules 1962
Pakistan Names And Emblems
(Prevention Of Unauthorised Use) Rules 1962
[Gazette of Pakistan,
19th October 1962]
S. R. O. 1108 (K)/62.-In exercise of the powers conferred by
section 8 of the Pakistan Names and Emblems (Prevention of Unauthorised
Use) Act, 1957 (XXVIII of 1957), the Central Government is pleased to make the
following rules, namely :‑
1. (1) These Rules may be called
the Pakistan Names and Emblems (Prevention of Unauthorised
Use) Rules, 1962.
(2) They shall come into force at
once.
2. In these rules, unless there
is anything repugnant in the subject or context,
(a) "Act" means the
Pakistan Names and Emblems (Prevention of Unauthorised
Use) Act, 1957 (XXVIII of 1957) ;
(b) "authorised officer" means the officer
authorised under sub-section (1) of section 3 of the
Act to grant permission, or impose conditions, for the use of name or emblem,
3. All applications for
permission to use or continue to use a name or emblem in any trade-mark or
design or in the title of any patent or for the purposes of any trade,
business, calling or profession or for any other purpose whatsoever, shall be
made to the Central Government or the authorised
officer in the form appended to these rules and shall be accom panied by a fee
of fifteen rupees.
4. The Central Government, or the
authorised officer may, on receipt of an application
under rule 3, call for any information from the applicant which the Central
Government or such officer may consider relevant and the applicant shall
furnish the information called for within a reasonable time.
5. Where permission under
subsection (1) of section 3 of the Act is granted subject to any condition, the
Central Government or the authorised officer may from
time to time added to or modify such condition and the condition so added or modified shall be deemed to be a
condition subject to which the permission had been granted.
